title: Story bed: tension (underscore)
description: A celli ostinato doubled an octave up by violas, a ticking woodblock and low piano octaves; the pulse, violas tremolo and the motif's tail (vibes, violins) from bar 8; high violins, tom rolls and a swell from bar 16. Underscore: the motif statements and lead lines are muted.
usage: The UNDERSCORE: the same bed with the motif and lead lines muted, for use under narration. Loops seamlessly. -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz for the narration; duck it with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). All four story beds share 75 BPM, so they can be switched on a bar line (every 3.2 s).
instruments: VSCO 2 celli and violas (fast), basses, violas tremolo, violins
VCSL woodblock, toms, bass drum, cymbal swell
selfReview: The tension story bed without the motif fragments, for use under speech. See bed-story-tension.
licence: Original composition (Zoora). Rendered from our own synthesis, VCSL (CC0) and MuseScore_General / FluidR3 (MIT) samples; see docs/AUDIO_LICENSES.md.
